title: Malmgren tweet on Bluegill tests and JFK Los Alamos visit

tellings.quote: tweeted am now reconstructing my personal interactions with Los Alamos Lawrence G bluegill ICBM interception tests 1961 62 and JFK visit to Los alos November 1962

plain: A former US government official named Harold Malmgren posted on social media that he was "now reconstructing my personal interactions with Los Alamos", the New Mexico nuclear weapons laboratory, during the Bluegill tests of 1961 and 1962. He describes these as tests of intercepting long-range nuclear missiles, and mentions President John F. Kennedy's visit to Los Alamos in November 1962. Michels reads the post aloud as a hint that Malmgren was close to nuclear secrets of that era, in an episode about reports of unknown craft watching nuclear sites.
